claims.text: The hotel overlooks the Riva degli Schiavoni, a few steps from Piazza San Marco, the Biennale Gardens and the Arsenale.

findings.quote: Overlooking the evocative Riva degli Schiavoni, just a few steps from Piazza San Marco, the Biennale Gardens, and the Arsenale

claims.text: The hotel is made up of seven palazzos, three of which directly face the canal.

findings.quote: a sprawling structure comprising seven palazzos, three of which directly face the canal

claims.text: The noble Gabrielli family were the original stewards of the 14th-century palazzo.

findings.quote: The noble Gabrielli family were well-known figures in Venetian politics and the original stewards of this 14th-century palazzo.

claims.text: The hotel has been held by the Perkhofer family for five generations.

findings.quote: Held by the Perkhofer family for five generations

claims.text: The interiors were designed by Andrea Auletta.

findings.quote: e glitzy, Andrea Auletta–designed interiors. After

claims.text: Rooms and suites use materials such as walnut wood and Italian marble, with golden details.

findings.quote: Each space is characterized by exquisite materials, such as walnut wood and Italian marble, and enhanced by golden details

claims.text: The spa features a large hot tub, a hammam, a sauna and a multi-sensory shower.

findings.quote: features a large hot tub, a hammam, a sauna, and a multi-sensory shower

claims.text: Breakfast is held in the Corte Grande, a former outdoor courtyard brought inside with a glass ceiling.

findings.quote: The Corte Grande, where breakfast is held
What used to be an outdoor courtyard has been cleverly brought inside with a glass ceiling

claims.text: The Felice al Gabrielli restaurant is helmed by Mirko Pistorello, who sources fresh regional ingredients from the lagoon and its surroundings.

findings.quote: is helmed by Mirko Pistorello, who takes great pride in sourcing fresh regional ingredients from the lagoon and its surroundings

claims.text: K Lounge Bar is named after Kafka, and its cocktails reference Venetian urban legends.

findings.quote: The cocktail menu at K Lounge Bar (named after Kafka, naturally) doubles as a history lesson, with each concoction referencing Venetian urban legends.

claims.text: The hotel's Craft Experiences include a visit to an authentic Murano glass factory at Berengo Studio.

findings.quote: Step into an authentic Murano glass factory and discover the magic of glass as it takes shape before your eyes, coaxed by master artisans.
Berengo Studio
Craft Experiences

claims.text: The Arsenale vaporetto stop is right outside the hotel.

findings.quote: The Arsenale vaporetto stop is right outside

claims.text: The panoramic rooftop terrace on the sixth floor has a view of Venice stretching from the Lido to the Dogana.

findings.quote: The panoramic terrace of Hotel Gabrielli on the sixth floor offers a unique view of Venice, stretching from the Lido to the Dogana.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a private terrace with views of the Lagoon, San Giorgio Maggiore and the Campanile of St. Mark's.

findings.quote: The Presidential Suite offers a private terrace with views of the Lagoon, San Giorgio Maggiore, and the Campanile of St. Mark's.

claims.text: The hotel has a 600-square-meter private garden and a private dock.

findings.quote: the 600-square-meter private garden, the private dock

claims.text: Past guests included Sigmund Freud, Adolf Loos and Franz Kafka.

findings.quote: Guests included everyone from Sigmund Freud and Adolf Loos to the dark allegorist Franz Kafka

claims.text: The hotel's original chandeliers have been restored by Seguso and Pauly & C, family-owned studios of Murano.

findings.quote: original chandeliers have been restored by Seguso and Pauly & C, two of the most important family-owned studios of Murano

claims.text: The spa is available to all guests from Tuesday through Sunday, and advance reservation is required.

findings.quote: It is available to all guests from Tuesday through Sunday, or can be booked for exclusive use, though advance reservation is required either way.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes there is no on-site parking; travel is by foot or water taxi.
WhataHotel notes heavy tourist foot traffic along the waterfront promenade in high season.
